title: Markdown Explorer
scope: Paste or drop standard markdown (CommonMark plus GFM tables, task lists and strikethrough, plus inline #tags) and explore it: tabs per file, a section tree from GitHub-style heading slugs, in-tab and cross-tab links with broken-link styling, backlinks, tag chips and a tag view, and Ctrl/Cmd+K search. Pasted HTML is shown as text; only http, https, mailto and in-app # links are live; images load only over https.
storage: localStorage key md-explorer-v1 (tabs and active tab) and md-explorer-theme; the app runs without them.
